justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/function/FailableLongUnaryOperator.java and src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/function/FailableTest.java. The target has very low fan-out: it only depends on java.util.Objects and java.util.function.LongUnaryOperator, plus self-references in its default methods and NOP/identity helpers. Repo-wide search found no production callers; the only external references are three unit-test methods in FailableTest that exercise nop(), identity(), and compose/andThen. This is not strong fan-in/fan-out evidence for a dependency hub.
